Daily Digest Thursday, April 9, 2026

Anthropic Makes AI Agents Turnkey, Canva Becomes a Marketing Platform, The Executive-Manager AI Gap

Anthropic makes AI agents turnkey for enterprise. Canva evolves from design tool to full marketing platform. The AI adoption gap explained.

  1. 1

    Anthropic Launches Claude Managed Agents

    Anthropic just made building enterprise AI agents dramatically easier. The new "Claude Managed Agents" product gives developers out-of-the-box infrastructure — agent harnesses, sandboxed environments, and cloud-based autonomous execution — that previously required entire engineering teams. Notion demoed using it for client onboarding automation. With Anthropic's ARR hitting $30B (3x since December), this is a direct play to capture enterprise AI spend before OpenAI's competing Frontier platform.

    Read on WIRED ↗
  2. 2

    Canva Acquires Simtheory + Ortto — Becomes Full Marketing Platform

    Canva's dual acquisition of Simtheory (AI agent management) and Ortto (marketing automation) signals a massive strategic shift. The $65B design tool is evolving into an end-to-end marketing platform — from creative ideation through campaign scaling and measurement. Both companies were founded by the same brothers, giving Canva unusual leadership continuity. For PMMs: your creative tools and your automation stack may soon be the same product.

    Read on Prism News ↗
  3. 3

    HBR: The Executive-Manager AI Disconnect Is Costing Companies

    Why do so many AI initiatives stall? Harvard Business Review argues it's not lack of investment — it's misalignment. Executives see transformation; middle managers see a very different reality on the ground. AI moved from "considering" to "committed" somewhere after ChatGPT, but the people charged with making it work aren't seeing the same picture as leadership. This disconnect is becoming an expensive blind spot.

    Read on Harvard Business Review ↗
  4. 4

    OutSystems: Agentic AI Mainstream, But 94% Worry About Sprawl

    New research confirms agentic AI has crossed into mainstream enterprise adoption — but 94% of organizations raise concerns about "agent sprawl." Financial services and tech companies report the highest deployment levels; France lags behind. The real challenge isn't building agents anymore. It's governing them.

    Read on Web And IT News ↗
  5. 5

    Stability AI Launches Brand Studio for Enterprise Creative Teams

    Stability AI rolled out Brand Studio — a creative production platform with curated model routing and precision editing tools aimed squarely at professional marketing teams. This isn't general-purpose image generation; it's enterprise creative infrastructure. The AI image generation market is bifurcating fast: consumer tools vs. brand-safe enterprise solutions. The Canva story is the one to watch. When a $65B design tool acquires both AI agent infrastructure AND marketing automation in a single day, that's not filling gaps — that's a platform play. The design-to-deployment pipeline is collapsing. Canva already has 265M users; now they're going after the CMO's entire workflow. Adobe should be paying attention.
